definitions.label: Lichtblick mixed robot scene publisher
definitions.description: Internal run-aware publisher for immutable FS150, Scout, and Mecanum models with one configured label style using foxglove_msgs/SceneUpdate.

fs150Models.description: Comma-separated FS150 Gazebo/VRPN model names derived from the immutable Swarm Asset snapshot

scoutModels.description: Comma-separated Scout Gazebo/VRPN model names derived from the immutable Swarm Asset snapshot

mecanumModels.description: Comma-separated Mecanum Gazebo/VRPN model names derived from the immutable Swarm Asset snapshot

markerColor.description: Canonical lowercase #rrggbb color applied to every robot text label
